snippet.title: Smells Like a Mushroom - Reveal Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
The Milky Way has become infested with creatures called Magic Mushrooms. To prevent a catastrophe, the brave Carrotado goes into space! Third-person sci-fi shooter with a bizarre story for a single-player and co-op.
